title: KeyEncryptionAlgorithm::EcdhEs is a public variant that decrypt_cek cannot use
description: smime-tree/src/key.rs: KeyEncryptionAlgorithm::EcdhEs is a public enum variant passed to DecryptionKey::decrypt_cek. The CLAUDE.md and inline comment document that EcdhEs is 'never produced by decrypt()' — instead, KARI (key agreement) goes through agree_ecdh(). So DecryptionKey implementors implementing decrypt_cek will never receive EcdhEs, yet it appears in their match arms as a required case. This is a type-level lie: the variant is public and must be handled, but is unreachable in normal usage. The fix is either to split the enum (KeyTransportAlgorithm for decrypt_cek, KeyAgreementAlgorithm for agree_ecdh) or to document the unreachability contract more prominently. As-is, implementors may write a panic or unreachable!() for EcdhEs and never notice that their code is dead.
close_reason: EcdhEs is a public variant representing the raw ECDH-ES scheme (without key wrap). It exists for forward compatibility — the trait's agree_ecdh method can receive it in a future version when direct key agreement is supported. Removing it would be a breaking change. The variant is documented and #[non_exhaustive] covers future additions.
